# Creative and engineering instructions for this repository

**Read and follow the repository-root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before making design or implementation decisions.** It contains the owner-approved **Living World Standard**.

**Default for user-facing work:** create distinctive, interactive, dimensional environments, not generic flat websites or card/button grids. Expect depth, light, living motion, physical materials, purposeful exploration and optional ambient sound where appropriate. Prefer free/open tools; keep mobile, accessibility, performance, and operational features fully functional. Do not present a technical proof-of-concept as finished visual quality.

**Exception:** when the owner explicitly requests simpler design, comply. For API/worker/backend-only tasks, do not invent a 3D front end; apply only relevant quality and usability principles.

Before closing a visual task, verify at desktop/mobile sizes and report what was actually tested, what is simulated, and what still falls short.
